topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Oh no, I can't believe what you found in your attic! I know you've been so excited about your new home, and now this. Those old things are like an uninvited guest, just sitting there, taking up space. I’m sure it’s not what you expected, and I wish I could have been there to help you clear it all out, right away, the moment you found it. Let’s plan a day, this weekend maybe, to sort it all out? I’ll bring some snacks and we can blast some music, make a fun day of it. You deserve a fresh start, attic and all.
